lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਆਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee is man kau mal laagee kaalaa hoaa siaahu ||
lines.translation: The filth of countless incarnations sticks to this mind; it has become pitch black.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਨਲੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਉਜਲੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣਿ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)nalee dhotee ujalee na hovaee je sau dhovan paahu ||
lines.translation: The oily rag cannot be cleaned by merely washing it, even if it is washed a hundred times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਬਦਲਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai ulatee hovai mat badalaahu ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive; his intellect is transformed, and he becomes detached from the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mail na lagaee naa phir jonee paahu ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, no filth sticks to him, and he does not fall into the womb again. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਾਂਢੀ ਇਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chahu jugee kal kaalee kaa(n)dhee ik utam padavee is jug maahi ||
lines.translation: Kali Yuga is called the Dark Age, but the most sublime state is attained in this age.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har keerat phal paaeeai jin kau har likh paahi ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the fruit, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this is his destiny, ordained by the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur parasaadee anadin bhagat har ucharahi har bhagatee maahi samaahi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, he worships the Lord night and day; he chants the Lord's Name, and remains absorbed in the Lord's devotional worship. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har mel saadh jan sa(n)gat mukh bolee har har bhalee baan ||
lines.translation: O Lord, unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, so that with my mouth, I may speak the sublime Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavaa har nit chavaa guramatee har ra(n)g sadaa maan ||
lines.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and constantly chant the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy the Lord's Love constantly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਉਖਧ ਖਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਤੇ ਦੁਖਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jap jap aukhadh khaadhiaa sabh rog gavaate dukhaa ghaan ||
lines.translation: I take the medicine of meditation on the Lord's Name, which has cured all diseases and multitudes of sufferings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se har jan poore sahee jaan ||
lines.translation: Those who do not forget the Lord, while breathing or eating - know them to be the perfect servants of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਣਿ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo guramukh har aaraadhade tin chookee jam kee jagat kaan ||22||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Lord in adoration end their subservience to the Messenger of Death, and to the world. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਉਥਾਰੈ ਦਬਿਓਹੁ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: re jan uthaarai dabiohu sutiaa gaee vihaai ||
lines.translation: O man, you have been tormented by a nightmare, and you have passed your life in sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kaa sabad sun na jaagio a(n)tar na upajio chaau ||
lines.translation: You did not wake to hear the Word of the True Guru's Shabad; you have no inspiration within yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਲਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sareer jalau gun baaharaa jo gur kaar na kamaai ||
lines.translation: That body burns, which has no virtue, and which does not serve the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagat jala(n)daa dith mai haumai doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: I have seen that the world is burning, in egotism and the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur saranaaee ubare sach man sabad dhiaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who seek the Guru's Sanctuary are saved; within their minds, they meditate on the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rate haumai gaee sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the soul-bride is rid of egotism, and she is glorified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir kai bhaanai sadaa chalai taa baniaa seegaar ||
lines.translation: If she walks steadily in the way of His Will, then she is adorned with decorations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sej suhaavee sadaa pir raavai har var paaiaa naar ||
lines.translation: Her couch becomes beautiful, and she constantly enjoys her Husband Lord; she obtains the Lord as her Husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa har marai na kade dukh laagai sadaa suhaagan naar ||
lines.translation: The Lord does not die, and she never suffers pain; she is a happy soul-bride forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har prabh mel laee gur kai het piaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord God unites her with Himself; she enshrines love and affection for the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa gur gopiaa aapanaa te nar buriaaree ||
lines.translation: Those who conceal and deny their Guru, are the most evil people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਹਤਿਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu tin kaa darasan naa karahu paapisat hatiaaree ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, let me not even see them; they are the worst sinners and murderers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਧਰਕਟ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohi ghar ghar phirahi kusudh man jiu dharakat naaree ||
lines.translation: They wander from house to house, with impure minds, like wicked, forsaken women.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee sa(n)gat mile guramukh savaaree ||
lines.translation: But by great good fortune, they may meet the Company of the Holy; as Gurmukhs, they are reformed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: har melahu satigur daiaa kar gur kau balihaaree ||23||
lines.translation: O Lord, please be kind and let me meet the True Guru; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te sukh oopajai phir dukh na lagai aai ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, peace is produced, and then, one does not suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਾਲੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa mit gaiaa kaalai kaa kichh na basaai ||
lines.translation: The cycle of birth and death is brought to an end, and death has no power over at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har setee man rav rahiaa sache rahiaa samaai ||
lines.translation: His mind is imbued with the Lord, and he remains merged in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hau balihaaree ti(n)n kau jo chalan satigur bhaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who walk in the Way of the True Guru's Will. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰੈ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai sudh na hovaee je anek karai seegaar ||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, purity is not obtained, even though the soul-bride may adorn herself with all sorts of decorations.
